g.text: Every frame tests a driver. Every generation reshapes the population.
repeat until crash • stuck • 30 s timeout
The network is never told how to drive—fitness decides what survives.
Progress dominates. Survival only breaks ties. Exploits are penalized.
after 1 s grace • stopped at 3 s

fitness = max(0, fresh tiles + survival − revisits − lingering)
